name: The majority voted against a [motion](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2017-02-13.3.2) introduced by Greens Senator [Nick McKim,](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/tasmania/nick_mckim) which means the motion failed. ### Motion text > *At the end of the motion [that the bill be read for a [second time](https://www.peo.gov.au/learning/fact-sheets/making-a-law.html)], add:* >> *", but the Senate is of the opinion that the Australian Parliament should have the right to deny entry to any Head of State or Head of Government on character grounds.".*
